name: Extreme Wall Hop Obby
desc:
Welcome to Extreme Wall Hop Obby! In this difficulty chart obby you'll face many obstacles and challenges along the way, but mostly wall hops... Can you make it past the impossible difficulty before rage quitting?

This obby has many Challenging, hard obstacles to face, either alone or with friends.

Follow HuskeeTheDev and join the group for a free skip.
